targets.arm64_apple: partial: integer leaf functions with control flow and memory

syntax.integer functions and parameters: partial: ASCII names, decimal literals, w/l, at most eight parameters
syntax.basic blocks, jumps, phi: partial: integer SSA blocks, jmp/jnz/ret/hlt, fallthrough, loops, dominance and parallel phi transfers
syntax.memory and allocation: partial: integer loads/stores, loadw/loadl aliases; entry-block positive constant alloc4/8/16 and alloc1/2 aliases; dynamic/non-entry allocation and blits remain

passes.parsing and validation: partial: integer/control-flow/memory SSA subset; full QBE syntax remains
passes.CFG, dominance and SSA construction: partial: CFG/dominance checks for SSA input; general SSA construction not implemented
passes.ABI lowering: partial: Apple AArch64 integer register arguments and returns
passes.instruction selection and assembly emiss: partial: Apple AArch64 integer/control-flow/memory leaf subset
passes.liveness, spilling and register allocati: not implemented; baseline gives every value a stack slot
